thread_text:
Alex: Quick async sync — fastpath tickets handshake. Need owners for ENG-5123 (kernel queueing regression) and ENG-5199 (KV warmup race). Short: 2.4rc saw increased tail latency when continuous batching + hot KV path enabled. Who can pick these up and coordinate canary?

Mira: I can start ENG-5123. Plan to reproduce on my perf rig first. Any repro steps yet?

Alex: Thanks. Repro steps are flaky but seen with long sequences + concurrent small requests. Steps: 1) start load with mix 90% short (<=64 tokens) 10% long (>=1024); 2) enable hotpath batching; 3) watch kernel queue length bump and stall.

TJ: tagging perf logs we captured earlier: https://internal.redwood/logs/fastpath-2026-03-10 — you can see kernel-queue backlog at 60s.

Sophie: For ENG-5199 (KV warmup) I can look — I suspect the warmup handshake is skipped when prefetch fails once. I have a small patch idea to retry prefetch x2.

Alex: OK great. Can we gate the canary on a fallback to older quantized kernel if queueing threshold hits? Want automatic mitigation.

Mira: Agree. Which threshold? current config uses `kernel.queue_threshold = 0.8` (fraction active). Maybe lower to 0.6 for the canary.

TJ: FYI, CI caught a flaky that looks related — CI-bot: Canary build failed on `runtime-e2e/coldstart` with a timeout. Link: https://ci.redwood/3212

CI-bot: @Alex @Mira failing test: runtime-e2e/coldstart — flake seen in 3/5 runs.

Alex: Thanks, CI-bot. Mira — that e2e flake aligns with your repro. If you can reproduce locally, add a focused test.

Sophie: Drafting a PR for the KV retry now. Will push to https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2894 when ready.

Mira: I'll pick up kernel-side instrumentation: add per-kernel queue histograms and a fastpath flag in traces. Small patch:```\ntracing.set("kernel.fastpath.queue_len", queue_len)\ntracing.set("kernel.fastpath.active", active_fraction)\n```\nI'll open PR tomorrow.

Alex: Nice. Owners summary: ENG-5123 -> Mira (kernel queueing + instrumentation); ENG-5199 -> Sophie (KV warmup retry). TJ will collect perf traces and coordinate canary runs. I will set the canary policy to fallback to `qkernel-v1` at threshold 0.6.

TJ: Timeline check — Mira/Sophie, can you aim for PRs by EOD Wednesday? We want canary early Thursday.

Mira: EOD Wed ok for a minimal instrumentation PR.

Sophie: I'll try to get the KV retry PR up by Wed afternoon — may need a quick test to validate.

Alex: Cool. I'll post the canary config in the console and tag ops-oncall for the Thursday run.

ops-oncall: +1, will monitor the canary and have rollback ready. Please ping on #incidents if latency spikes.

TJ: Also pinging runtime-owners for code review: @Mira @Sophie please request reviews from @core-kernel and @kv-team. Keeps things moving.

Mira: Will do. One more ask: Sophie, if your retry adds extra load, could it amplify queueing? We should limit retry concurrency (max 2 retries, exponential backoff).

Sophie: Good call. I'll implement capped backoff. Patch note will mention `kv.prefetch.retries = 2` and `kv.prefetch.backoff_ms = [50, 200]`.

Alex: Perfect. I'll update the canary policy after PRs land. Thanks everyone — breathing room for async reviews. :thumbsup:

TJ: Quick checklist before canary:
- Mira: instrument + repro test
- Sophie: retry + tests
- Alex: canary policy + fallback
- TJ: perf traces + baseline
- ops-oncall: monitor/rollback ready

Mira: Added tasks to ENG board (ENG-5123 -> assigned).

Sophie: ENG-5199 ticket updated and linked to PR when ready.

Alex: If anything blocks, drop a short note here. Otherwise we'll reconvene after the canary results.

CI-bot: Build queued for PR 2894. Will post status when complete. :gear:
